summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Any new secret reference in config/secrets.yaml must use vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY> and never an environment-variable placeholder.
- Never enable a new Celery task in ledgerly/tasks/ unless perf/locust_tasks.py demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Run “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” in order, one step at a time.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Carry on during the operator’s one-hour meeting.
- Stop the tenacity refactor; revisit it next sprint.
- Fix the nightly reconciliation job in ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py double-counting refunds.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Scheduler recurrence timestamp expression; `resolve_timezone` uses `zoneinfo.ZoneInfo`; unknown zones raise `ZoneInfoNotFoundError`.
- Snapshot: `webhook_cutover_20250308`.
- API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` superseded and shut down.
- Currency: `billing/currency.py`, `round_money`, `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Five-attempt webhook retry decorator; resent customer emails.

## Plan and progress
- Cutover steps 1–5 done, including image update, service selector, and replay job creation.
- Exact next replay command: `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a` (status unknown).
- Refund double-counting fix pending.
- Ruff found two E501 violations; fix pending.

## Recent work
- Removed worker aliasing, passed 118 tests, deduplicated CLI currency flags, and passed 37 CLI/command tests.
